Content: An online apparel brand starts a holiday weekend with `c` winter coats in stock at its main fulfillment center. On Saturday morning, to prepare for a flash sale, the logistics manager increases the inventory of winter coats by `40%`. By Sunday evening, after a high volume of customer orders, the remaining stock of winter coats decreases by `15%` from Saturday's updated amount.
Which of the following expressions represents the final number of winter coats in stock?

At the beginning of the school year, a high school media club has `m` active student members. After a promotional assembly, the club's active membership increases by `25%`. A month later, due to scheduling conflicts with winter sports, the active membership decreases by `40%` from that new total.
Which expression represents the final number of active members remaining in the club?

A mobile software startup allocates `s` `text(gigabytes)` of cloud server storage to hold user profile data. To accommodate a new app feature, the development team increases the storage allocation by `110%`. Two weeks later, after implementing a data compression tool, the team reduces the newly updated server storage allocation by `20%`.
Which of the following expressions represents the final cloud server storage allocation, in `text(gigabytes)`?

A local electronics retailer receives a shipment of premium headphones that wholesale for $x$ `text(dollars)` each. The store manager increases the wholesale price by `60%` to set the baseline retail price. During a clearance event, the store offers a discount that decreases this baseline retail price by `30%`.
Which expression represents the final sale price of the headphones, in `text(dollars)`?

A commercial fruit orchard expects a standard baseline harvest of $b$ bushels of peaches. Due to optimal rainfall early in the season, the expected harvest increases by `15%`. However, a late-season frost damage incident causes the updated harvest yield to decrease by `45%`.
Which of the following expressions represents the final number of bushels of peaches harvested?

A boutique clothing store starts the spring season with a baseline stock of `200` designer denim jackets. To prepare for a holiday weekend promotion, the store owner increases the inventory of denim jackets by `30%`. By the end of the weekend sale, high customer demand causes the remaining stock of denim jackets to decrease by `40%` from the weekend's updated total.
What is the final number of denim jackets left in stock?

A high school after-school weightlifting club begins the semester with `50` active student members. After a school-wide wellness assembly, the club's student registration increases by `60%`. `text(One month)` later, due to scheduling conflicts with spring track tryouts, the number of active members decreases by `25%` from that peak registration total.
How many active members remain in the club?

A software startup allocates a baseline of `text(400 gigabytes)` of cloud server storage to handle its initial application database. To support a new video-sharing feature, the engineering team increases the server storage capacity by `150%`. `text(Two weeks)` later, after implementing an efficient data compression algorithm, the team successfully decreases their updated storage footprint by `10%`.
What is the new server storage allocation, in `text(gigabytes)`?

A commercial citrus orchard records a baseline harvest of `800` bushels of oranges during a standard tracking season. The following year, an automated irrigation upgrade causes the seasonal yield to increase by `15%`. However, an unexpected early frost during the picking cycle causes the updated harvest yield to decrease by `20%`.
How many bushels of oranges were successfully harvested?

A regional shipping firm utilizes a baseline of `150` standard cargo vans across its delivery network. After optimizing their delivery routes and retiring older models, the firm decreases its updated van count by `12%`. `text(Six months)` later, due to expanding contract demands in a metropolitan area, the fleet supervisor increases the number of active vans by `50%`.
What is the final number of active cargo vans in the delivery network?
